title: flywheel: orch_observe input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_observe instead; removed in v4.0] Single-call read-only session-state snapshot. Aggregates checkpoint, beads, agent-mail, ntm, git, WIZARD artifacts, and a cached doctor verdict (60s TTL) into one structured envelope. Idempotent + non-mutating; designed for fast session recovery without staging multiple round-trips. Wall-clock budget < 1.5s; degraded probes mark their sub-section as `unavailable: true`.
